items.change: Move the cap->pause composition (enforceMessageCap) and the stop-all composition (checkStopAllActive) out of src/store into src/mcp/guards.ts so no src/store file imports src/core; update the existing stop-all and cap tests to import the compositions from src/mcp.

items.change: Guard agreementsRepo.updateAgreementStatus so only an 'offered' agreement can be answered and only by its recipient (responder is not the offerer and is a participant of the agreement's thread); the function returns whether the update happened.
items.proof: test/store/agreements.test.ts attempts the forbidden update directly (offerer, non-participant, already-settled row) and asserts refusal plus an unchanged row; recipient updates still succeed; pnpm check passes.

items.change: Add negative near-miss secret-scan tests: short .env-style values, a too-short AKIA string and a too-short xoxb token must NOT be blocked.
items.proof: test/core/guards.test.ts near-miss cases all expect null and pass.

items.change: Implement src/mcp: identity.ts (agent id from env PARLEY_AGENT_ID with cwd-folder fallback, register + heartbeat per call), guards.ts (stop-all + cap compositions, post checks), rules.ts (.parley/rules.md reminder + once-per-session text), server.ts (McpServer with talk/inbox/agree, stdio serve, retention on start), each tool returning structuredContent plus a one-paragraph text summary.
items.proof: pnpm check passes; server builds and registers exactly the three tools with zod input schemas.

items.change: Implement the three tools per PLAN section 5: talk (stop-all, secret scan, thread creation/postable checks, idempotent send incl. everyone fan-out, reply marks reply_to replied with events, outlook from recipient presence, poll-based wait_for_reply_s), inbox (deliver+read marking of my pending messages with events, own sent receipts, decisions, who), agree (offer/accept/counter/reject via the guarded store update; claim/renew/release with overlap conflicts).
items.proof: pnpm check passes; unit-level mcp tests cover outlook, secret blocking, rules reminder and claim conflicts.

items.change: Integration tests with the SDK InMemoryTransport: two fake agents (two server instances sharing one in-memory SQLite db) exchange messages; receipts move sent->delivered->read->replied correctly; an agreement is offered and answered by its recipient; a forbidden answer is refused.
